meta.name: manage-mounts
meta.description: Configure which host directories agent containers can access. View, add, or remove mount allowlist entries. Triggers on "mounts", "mount allowlist", "agent access to directories", "container mounts".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理容器可访问的主机目录挂载
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要控制 agent 容器能访问哪些主机目录
copy.tagline_en: Manage which host directories agent containers can access
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control which host directories agent containers can access

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以查看当前容器可访问的主机目录白名单，并能按你的要求添加或移除目录，同时为每个目录设置只读或读写权限。配置保存在 ~/.config/nanoclaw/mount-allowlist.json。
howto.when: 当你说到“mounts”“mount allowlist”等关键词，或要求查看、添加、移除容器可访问的目录时触发。

say.text: 查看当前允许容器访问哪些目录
say.note: 显示白名单及每个目录的读写状态。

say.text: 把 /home/user/data 添加为只读目录
say.note: 验证路径后写入配置，新容器生效。
更新白名单，新生成的容器立即生效。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can show the current mount allowlist for NanoClaw agent containers, add or remove host directories, and set each as read-only or read-write. The config is saved to ~/.config/nanoclaw/mount-allowlist.json.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "mounts", "mount allowlist", etc., or ask to view, add, or remove directories containers can access.

say_en.text: Show which directories containers can access now
say_en.note: Displays the allowlist and access modes.
Validates the path and writes the config.
Updates the allowlist, applied to new containers.
